title: Tabs configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.TabsAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

ContentAutoHeight.description: Sizes the content area to the active tab instead of the tallest tab.

Height.description: Height of the tabs content (CSS length); auto by default.

JustifyHeaders.description: Stretches the header items to fill the available width.

StartingTab.description: Zero-based index of the tab active when built; cannot be changed afterwards.

TabsOrientation.description: horizontal (headers above the content) or vertical (headers beside it).

TabsVerticalPosition.description: Side of the content where vertical headers sit: left or right.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
